ruling: Frame 1141 is the first frame of the worried-eyes appearance on the orange percent disc; nothing else in the frame changes vs 1140. The disc region at 1141 is pixel-identical (above threshold) to 1155, and EP0036 (S0015 representative) shows the same eyes. So the eyes state spans at least 1141 and 1155 (endpoints identical; intermediate frames 1142-1154 not individually compared, so mid-span stasis is inferred, not measured). The prior draft S0015 interval [1142,1155] is off by one at its start: observed onset is 1141. Do not copy stateID S0015 to G007.02 as a separate state; fold G007.02 into S0015 as its exact onset, i.e. S0015 observed range 1141..1155 (end 1155 only bounded, next change = dollar bill entry after 1155).
